SRC-087:R001.text: Do NOT create another scheduler ticket.

SRC-087:R003.text: Do NOT replay already-completed account/limit/prepared implementation.

SRC-087:R004.text: Do NOT discard valid E-1881..E-1888 evidence.

SRC-087:R005.text: Do NOT mark unfinished workflow placeholders complete merely because their enums or UI fields exist.

SRC-087:R006.text: Do not ask for ordinary continuation between milestones.

SRC-087:R007.text: Do NOT interpret UNKNOWN as "not implemented".

SRC-087:R008.text: Therefore real PRIME/SYNC claims must remain conservative.

SRC-087:R009.text: Do not treat this external validation as a replacement for the real Windows and Qt gates.

SRC-087:R010.text: Do not create a parallel scheduler.

SRC-087:R011.text: Do not remove the gate before the corresponding implementation is safe.

SRC-087:R012.text: Do NOT start with visual polish.

SRC-087:R013.text: Do NOT consume real provider quota merely to make PRIME tests green.

SRC-087:R014.text: Every mutation of an active execution must prove:

SRC-087:R015.text: A stale worker must not update a receipt after takeover.

SRC-087:R016.text: Do not rely solely on mutable owner_id text.

SRC-087:R017.text: Do not generate unrelated duplicate work.

SRC-087:R018.text: never automatically launch another provider process merely because lease expired.

SRC-087:R021.text: Manual Project Room launcher and Prepared Scheduler must share one authoritative launch layer.

SRC-087:R022.text: Do not let this become a permanent second launcher stack.

SRC-087:R023.text: Do NOT force their argv to be literally identical.

SRC-087:R024.text: Never bypass a user custom command silently.

SRC-087:R026.text: Avoid permanent provider if/elif logic scattered through:

SRC-087:R027.text: Never infer FIRST_CONSUMING_USE solely from observing a countdown.

SRC-087:R028.text: Do not query the internet during normal operation.

SRC-087:R029.text: Do not consume model quota to discover a flag.

SRC-087:R030.text: Model must map to the correct quota bucket where providers expose separate pools.

SRC-087:R031.text: PRIME must refuse UNKNOWN bucket mapping.

SRC-087:R032.text: SYNC must not claim quota alignment when window mapping is unknown.

SRC-087:R033.text: Do NOT pipe an audit through Claude/Codex stdin as a substitute.

SRC-087:R034.text: Do not create the final archive hours in advance by default.

SRC-087:R035.text: Do NOT enqueue a second audit.

SRC-087:R036.text: Do not implement it as sequential normal launches.

SRC-087:R037.text: Do not store comma-separated account IDs inside the current single account_id field.

SRC-087:R040.text: Do not retry already-started members automatically.

SRC-087:R044.text: Do not run an autonomous coding command merely to start a timer.

SRC-087:R046.text: Do not consume real user quota.

SRC-087:R047.text: Do not silently choose arbitrary account.

SRC-087:R049.text: Do not reserve accounts hours ahead by default.

SRC-087:R050.text: An enabled prepared job must never disappear into silent waiting.

SRC-087:R051.text: Running Test Now today must NOT consume tomorrows ONE_SHOT scheduled event.

SRC-087:R053.text: Do not make the operator accidentally delete the future job by testing it.

SRC-087:R056.text: NEXT_USABLE must consider ALL hard bottlenecks.

SRC-087:R058.text: Do not use zero meter for UNKNOWN.

SRC-087:R059.text: Prepared jobs must consult current process state.

SRC-087:R060.text: Do not keyboard-paste into an arbitrary terminal.

SRC-087:R062.text: Do not scan the whole machine.

SRC-087:R066.text: Do not waste quota repeating it without purpose.

SRC-087:R067.text: Do NOT automatically consume live quota during development.

SRC-087:R069.text: Do not blanket mark all 203 VERIFIED.

SRC-087:R070.text: Do not bump Widget version merely because scheduler code changed.
